text:
amira: Quick pre-panel ping — candidate (Kate) for 3:00pm PT asks for a 30m buffer after the session and closed captions enabled. Can we shift to 3:30pm PT? Also need a non-panel scribe for debrief.
sam: 3:30 works for me.
tyler: I can move but I have a 4:00 deployment review, so need a hard 10m buffer before that.
people-ops-bot: Heads up — panel packet created for 6976543210. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/panels/6976543210 :page_with_curl:
amira: @jess can you take scribe if you're free? prefer async bullets rather than full transcript.
jess: I can scribe async, but need someone to own live notes first 5m in case of followups. I'll post bullets in thread within 30m after the call.
amira: Thanks. Rubric tweak proposal: for the system-design section, remove the generic "API design" row and add a 0-3 anchor for "latency & cost tradeoffs". This is to better calibrate infra tradeoffs questions. Any objections?
sam: No objections. +1 to adding an example prompt to calibration doc so everyone grades consistently.
tyler: I'll add a small PR with the rubric change. snippet of suggested change:
```
- API design: evaluate endpoints and auth (0-4)
+ Latency & cost tradeoffs: identify bottlenecks and pricing impact (0-3)
+ Example prompt: "Design a low-latency inference path for a high-traffic endpoint. What are 3 levers you would use?"
```
amira: Nice. @people-ops-bot can you version the rubric file when Tyler's PR lands?
people-ops-bot: Will create a rubric version and notify channel when PR merges.
ops-riya: Closed captions confirmed for the room. Also set recording only if candidate consents — remind host at start.
oncall-sre: AV sanity check: room link is https://zoom.redwood.com/j/987654321 passcode: 2468. I'll test audio 10 min before.
jess: Small ops note — if the panel needs to rescore, we'll use the 'post-debrief normalization' flow in the handbook. I'll link it in the debrief.
amira: And last ask — can someone kick off the quick post-interview smoke eval (end-to-end prompt generator) so we can see infra perf under real prompt shape? tag it eval/quick-smoke.
sam: I'll queue the eval right after the call & ping results here.
tyler: PR for rubric posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rubrics/pull/88 (wip). lgtm from me. :thumbsup:
jess: Scribe plan: bullets + top-3 takeaways + any score ties + link to recording (if consent).
amira: Awesome — thanks everyone. See you at 3:30pm PT. :wave:
